title: Ty Simpson will play in the preseason; no decision has been made about Stetson Bennett playing

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ty Simpson will play in the preseason; no decision has been made about Stetson Bennett playing
sources.description: As the Rams prepare for the first of their three preseason games, coach Sean McVay has made a decision as to whether one of his top backup quarterbacks will play.
